The story
"Two years ago, I took a step back. Not because I was done — but because I was building something new."
— Coach Hasan

Blueprint Padel is built on a simple idea: good padel, like any good build, starts with the fundamentals. Every session works from a plan — footwork, positioning and repeatable technique — not just hitting balls until time runs out.

Private coaching

The rate card.

One-on-one lessons at Arturf Padel Arena. Off-peak runs 9am–3pm on weekdays; peak is after 3pm and all weekend.
